# CMT Justice

> Ann Arbor-based personal injury and medical malpractice law firm specializing in birth injuries, surgical errors, and healthcare negligence cases.

Goethel Engelhardt, PLLC provides comprehensive legal representation for victims of medical malpractice and personal injury in Michigan. The firm focuses on complex healthcare cases including birth injuries, surgical errors, anesthesia complications, and diagnostic failures.
